why: The lookahead's weights refitted under ADR 0102. Greedy now prices a purchase by what it adds over the spells of its kind, and lookahead-34, fitted against the Greedy before it, beats it only 50.7 % of 400 matches where it took 94.8 % (journal, 2026-10-08): the table's strong bot is no stronger than Greedy. So this rung starts from lookahead-34, the set the table seats, and plays every candidate against the new Greedy on the first 60 benchmark seeds (learning/experiments/lookahead-seeds-60.json), because against Greedy the lookahead now sits near even and 30 seeds would not tell one candidate from the next. search-23 stays in the panel on the first 10 seeds only, as a floor: the lookahead on lookahead-34 beats it 12 of 12 there, and it is three times dearer to play than Greedy (15.7 seconds a seed against 5.5 by the local rate). 4 rounds of 5, seed 0, about 3.5 hours by that rate, the hold-out included; search 34 ran in four fifths of its estimate. No check opponent, for the same budget. What would make it a rung: a set that beats lookahead-34 against Greedy on the 60 unseen seeds, without falling against search-23.
